OmniGlobal
Global technology company with a focus on artificial intelligence and data analytics

Apex Corp
A technology company that acquired and developed Project Chronos

NovaTech
A technology company founded by Dr. Alice Vance in January 2017

Project Chronos
A project developed by NovaTech to advance the field of artificial intelligence

Vertex AI
A company that acquired Project Chronos from OmniGlobal in February 2024

Bob Miller
A CEO of NovaTech from May 2019 to April 2024

Sarah Jenkins
A CEO of NovaTech from March 2021 to April 2024

Dr. Alice Vance
The founder of NovaTech and its first CEO from January 2017 to May 2019

March 2021
A significant date when Sarah Jenkins was appointed as the CEO of NovaTech

May 2019
A significant date when Bob Miller was appointed as the CEO of NovaTech

April 2024
A significant date when Sarah Jenkins' sudden resignation led to Bob Miller being re-appointed as the acting CEO of NovaTech
